name: NHN Cloud Gwangju AI Data Center (National AI Data Center)
notes: National AI Data Center at Oryong-dong, Buk-gu (near GIST); NHN selected Feb 2021 to build/operate cloud infra; operational, minister (MSIT) visits 2025; part of national AI computing ramp (GPU expansion, 18,000 GPUs by 2026). Government-NHN operated AI facility.

name: NIRS Gwangju Center (NCIS Gwangju)
developer: NIRS / Ministry of Interior and Safety (government)
notes: Government disaster-recovery/data center established 2017-07-26; Songam-ro 143beon-gil 34, Seo-gu; backs up Daejeon main center (role in 2025 Daejeon fire recovery). Public-sector DC.

name: SK-OpenAI JV Data Center (candidate site, Cheomdan 3)
notes: ETNews 2026-03-04: SK-OpenAI JV datacenter site likely Gwangju Cheomdan district (Cheomdan 3 spans Gwangsan-gu/Buk-gu/Jangsung-gun); candidate-site reporting only, no land/permit/power evidence; Cheomdan 3 designated AI cluster zone. Rumor-grade lead.

name: Kakao Data Center Ansan
notes: Kakao's first in-house hyperscale DC at Hanyang Univ ERICA campus, Ansan; completed Sep 2023, operating from Jan 2024; 47,378 sqm, 4,000 racks, 120,000 servers, 6EB. Official first-party release.

name: Koramco-DCI Sihwa AI Data Center
developer: Koramco Asset Management + DCI Data Centers (Brookfield affiliate)
notes: 40MW AI datacenter at Sihwa National Industrial Complex, Ansan; groundbreaking announced 2026-08-08 (Maeil Business). Koramco and Brookfield-affiliate DCI Data Centers.

name: LG U+ Pyeongchon Mega Center (incl. Pyeongchon 2)
notes: Hyperscale IDC in Anyang (Pyeongchon); opened Jul 2016, Asia's largest at opening; Uptime Tier-III certified; PUE ~1.4; LG Corp reported ~165MW planned power supply; Pyeongchon 2 expansion (40,450 sqm, 200,000+ servers) per LG U+ official insight pages.

name: Dongyang Bucheon Samjeong AI Hub Center
notes: AI-specialized DC at Samjeong-dong, Bucheon; groundbreaking 2026-05-21; total power supply 9.8MW / IT load 7MW; PF KRW 159bn; construction by DL E&C (KRW 126.8bn); LG CNS + DCPLATFORM collaboration; company targets KRW 1tn data-center platform.

name: Gapyeong Data Center (Hasaek-ri)
notes: KRW 1.6tn private DC at Hasaek-ri, Gapyeong-eup; 84,000 sqm site, B2/F4; ~3x NAVER GAK scale; 40MW-class x3 facilities + support; MOU Aug 2023 (Mastern Investment/Enfield); management plan gazetted early 2025 via Gyeonggi-do; design during 2025, construction start Jan-Feb 2026, completion 2028 (Yonhap).

name: Digital Realty Korea ICN11 (Gurae-dong Data Center)
notes: Gurae-dong 6877-9; building permit 2021 (95,051 sqm GFA, B4/F8); construction start report rejected by Gimpo city Jul 2024 after resident opposition (EMF concerns) + developer administrative suit; project restarted May 2025 with DL E&C construction contract; ~80MW class. Status: construction resumption 2025.

name: Equinix SL2x / SL4 (Hyangdong)
notes: SL4 and SL2x at Hyangdong-dong, Deogyang-gu, Goyang; operational interconnection/campus hub (with SL1 Sangam, Seoul); ZDNet 2026-04 field report confirms operation; Equinix official Seoul page.

name: Equinix SL3x (Goyang)
notes: Equinix Korea building SL3x after SL2x/SL4 in Goyang (exec statements 2025); under construction.

name: SK Broadband Ilsan IDC
notes: SK Broadband Ilsan (Il-san) center per SKB press/blog roundup (Bundang smart IDC release names Ilsan among existing centers); operational telco IDC.

name: Goyang Deokyi-dong Data Center
notes: Construction start report for Deokyi-dong DC rejected by Goyang city amid resident opposition (local media 2026); project blocked at city level.

name: KINX Gwacheon IDC
notes: KINX Gwacheon data center opened Oct 2024; KINX network platform (IX) hub; official KINX page + ETNews coverage.
